deck.confirmDeleteHint: “{title}” leaves the deck for everyone who opens it. The version history keeps it.
deck.deleteFailed: The slide could not be deleted. Try again.
deck.stale: Someone saved a newer version of this deck, so your change was not made. The newer deck is shown now.
deck.failedPlain: The change was not saved. Try again.
deck.notesFailed: The notes could not be read.
deck.listFailed: The slide list of this deck could not be read.
deck.busy: Wait for the last change to be saved, then try again.
deck.staleUnread: Someone saved a newer version of this deck, so your change was not made. Reload the page to see it.
